zh: a North American wild animal of the dog family
en: a North American wild animal of the dog family
words that show that you approve of and admire somebody/something
ex: The team coach singled out two players for special praise.
教练提出两名队员给予特别表扬。

zh: （非洲传统的）赞歌表演者，赞歌艺人（创作并表演赞颂酋长或其他要人的音乐和诗歌）
en: (in traditional African society) a person who writes and performs music and poetry in order to praise a leader or other important person
ex: Traditionally, a praise singer accompanies the chief on important occasions.
传统上，在重要场合，表扬歌手会陪伴首席。

zh: a popular US song during the Second World War, written in 1942 by Frank Loesser. It was based on words said by a US Navy chaplain (= priest) during the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor.
en: a popular US song during the Second World War, written in 1942 by Frank Loesser. It was based on words said by a US Navy chaplain (= priest) during the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor.

a small vehicle on four wheels for a baby to go out in, pushed by a person on foot
ex: She was pushing her baby along in a pram.
她把宝宝放在婴儿车里推着走。

首席歌手手执麦克风，神气地走来走去。

en: a person who plays tricks on people as a joke
ex: Student pranksters have done considerable damage to the school buildings.
恶作剧的学生对学校的建筑造成相当大的损坏。
